rv.q: If you are down to play along, there are a wealth of wonders for the mind’s eye to explore.
But this ninety-minute production also numbs the audience, making it agonizing to watch.

cn.t: Critics are divided on this atmospheric piece inspired by Bowie's "Warszawa," with praise for its imaginative approach and evocative staging countered by criticism of its bleak, joyless tone.
